BL-1447 — A replay tip missing any path the parcel's own commits changed is refused before it is published: the land step compares the replay against the cited tip path by path and answers LAND_ESCALATE replay-incomplete naming every missing path instead of LAND_REPLAY - the net that would have refused BL-1424's replay on 2026-09-06 before LAND_PUBLISHED
What it solves: Minted 2026-09-06 by the specifier on QA's note and incident evidence
(see BL-1446 for the shared source). Split from BL-1446 on purpose: the
net reads trees, the fix reads history; the net stays valuable after the
fix because the next attribution bug is not this one. Both touch
`land_step_lib.bb`,…
Approval context: A new feature file is authored here, so it needs a tap. No choice is posed and there are no ruling_options. Minted by the specifier on QA's priority-00 note (2026-09-06T17:40Z) as the sibling of BL-1446 (the root cause); QA's evidence recommends exactly this cross-check. It also retires the interim…
